title: Price objections
purpose: What to say when a customer doubts the price; the weakest check on most scorecards.
facts: Method: find the comparison, then say what is in the number.
Eight objections with answers in one table; the answers point to the economy tier, the photo and measurement, the diagnostic-fee policy and the no-cash-price rule.
Rules: no price matching; cheaper = a cheaper parts tier, never a quiet discount; up to 10 % with a reason on the order; say the warranty terms.
The quoted competitor figure "$300" is a customer's words in an example, not a price of ours.
"Pads at 2 millimetres; new is 10" is an example measurement.
The calls design's level-2 objection line ("Did somebody quote it lower? Here's what's in that number") is this page's method.

rows.They say: "That is a lot more than I expected."
rows.You say: "What were you expecting? ... Okay. Here is what is in ours:" then the parts by name, the labour, the warranty
"For pads and rotors, or pads alone? Which pads?" Usually it is pads alone, or the cheapest pad. Then: "Ours at that level would be..." and give the economy price from the list
"I can do it with the economy parts for [price]. Same labour, same warranty on our work. What I would not do is skip the rotors if they are under size." That is a different job, not a discount
"Of course. What would help you decide: the price, or whether it really needs doing?" Then answer that. Then offer to hold a time
The photo and the number. "Your pads are at 2 millimetres; new is 10. I would not go another month." If it can wait, say it can wait. They will believe you next time

rows.They say: "Why do I pay for diagnosis if I am getting it fixed here?"
rows.You say: "Because finding it is the skilled part, and you get the result in writing whatever you decide." Diagnostic fees
"We will look at it ourselves first. If they are right you have lost nothing."

rows.They say: "Somebody here used to give me a cash price."
rows.You say: "We do not have one. The price is the same however you pay." Discount policy

list_items.item: We do not match prices. We explain ours. A customer who only wants the lowest number is allowed to go and get it.
Cheaper means a cheaper tier of parts, said out loud, never a quiet discount. You may give up to 10 % for a reason and the reason goes on the order.
"It is all warrantied" is not an answer. Say what the warranty is: 24 months or 24,000 miles, parts and labour (pads and work vehicles 12 months).
If you do not know why our price is what it is, find out before the next call. Travis and I will always explain a line.

new_facts: No price matching. Reason: an objection page needs a stated position; it creates no ERP footprint.
notes_for_russian_writer: Russian objections: «дорого», «в гараже дешевле», «у официалов сказали», «а со своими запчастями?» (very common: point to the customer-parts page), «скидку сделаете?». Same method.
